bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made significant roster moves on October 17, including placing Coby Bryant and Hayden Large on Reserve/Injured while signing James Lynch and Jack Sanborn to the active roster, and the team also agreed to acquire defensive back Clark Phillips III and a 2027 fifth-round pick from Atlanta in exchange for defensive lineman Gervon Dexter Sr. The Chicago Bears have placed defensive back Coby Bryant and tight end Hayden Large on Reserve/Injured, signed defensive lineman James Lynch and linebacker Jack Sanborn to the active roster and signed 14 players to the practice squad as part of moves to comply with the NFL's mandatory 53-man roster limit.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers made several roster moves on Saturday ahead of their Sunday night matchup against the Dallas Cowboys, including activating WR Savion Williams off injured reserve/designated for return, placing DT Jonathan Ford, DT Javon Hargrave and WR Skyy Moore on injured reserve, and elevating EDGE Arron Mosby and WR Coleman Owen from the practice squad to the active roster for gameday . Despite these injury-related losses, Green Bay enters the primetime game fresh off a dominant Week 5 win, as the Packers had a number of standouts in a 31-7 blowout victory over the Chicago Bears, and on Sunday night against a woeful Dallas Cowboys defense, they'll have another opportunity to shine .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are riding a 5-0 start into their Week 6 bye, with much of the latest buzz centered on potential trade activity ahead of the deadline as GM Nolan Teasley is expected to be "really, really active" before the trade deadline to improve the roster. Injury updates also made news, as the team is hopeful running back Jordan Mason will be ready to return from injured reserve for their Week 7 game against the Colts after healing from thumb surgery during the bye week .
